name: Eyes of Minute Seeing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks that rely on sight.
text: Worn over your eyes, these crystal lenses sharpen your sight dramatically for anything within 1 foot of you. When you search an area or study an object that close, Intelligence (Investigation) checks that depend on sight have Advantage.
